mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_no, product_id, product_title, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, buyer_name, buyer_phone, address, status ) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{productId}, #{productTitle}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{buyerName}, #{buyerPhone}, #{address}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, product_id, product_title, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, buyer_name, buyer_phone, address, status, created_at, paid_at FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, order_no, product_id, product_title, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, buyer_name, buyer_phone, address, status, created_at, paid_at FROM orders WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
